f.title: Have a risk-based PV programme documented in Spanish under document control
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments must have a pharmacovigilance programme appropriate to the risk profile identified for their products, documented in Spanish and properly standardised in a document management system.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments
rows.quote: Los titulares de registros sanitarios, laboratorios farmacéuticos y establecimientos fabricantes deben contar con un programa de Farmacovigilancia acorde al perfil de riesgo identificado para sus productos. Este programa debe estar documentado en idioma español y debidamente estandarizado en un sistema de gestión documental.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments must have a Pharmacovigilance programme appropriate to the risk profile identified for their products. This programme must be documented in the Spanish language and duly standardised in a document management system.

f.title: Cover all marketed products, activities, owners and verification in the PV programme
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance programme must cover all products authorised for marketing and describe the pharmacovigilance activities implemented, the persons responsible and the verification mechanisms the establishment uses to carry out the programme.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments
rows.quote: El programa de Farmacovigilancia del titular de registro sanitario, laboratorio farmacéutico y establecimiento fabricante debe enmarcar a todos los productos autorizados para su comercialización que describa las actividades de farmacovigilancia que se implementen, los responsables y los mecanismos de verificación utilizados por el establecimiento para la ejecución del programa.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The Pharmacovigilance programme of the marketing authorisation holder, pharmaceutical laboratory and manufacturing establishment must cover all products authorised for marketing, describing the pharmacovigilance activities implemented, the persons responsible and the verification mechanisms used by the establishment to execute the programme.

f.title: Appoint a qualified physician or pharmacist resident in Colombia to lead the PV programme
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance programme must be led by a physician or pharmaceutical chemist with training authorised by the Ministry of National Education and the experience to perform the role, with specific dedication and availability. Holders, laboratories and manufacturers must ensure that this professional is permanently and continuously available to the organisation, resides and operates in Colombia to meet requirements, and keeps their details up to date through the means INVIMA provides.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments
rows.quote: El programa de farmacovigilancia debe estar a cargo de un profesional médico o químico farmacéutico con la formación debidamente autorizada por el Ministerio de Educación Nacional y la experiencia para la realización de sus funciones, con dedicación específica y disponibilidad para este fin. Para ello, los titulares de registros sanitarios, laboratorios farmacéuticos, establecimientos fabricantes deben garantizar que, el profesional a cargo esté a disposición de la organización de forma permanente y continua, residir y operar en Colombia para atender los diferentes requerimientos, así como mantener actualizados sus datos a través del medio que el Invima disponga para tal fin.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The pharmacovigilance programme must be under the responsibility of a medical professional or pharmaceutical chemist with training duly authorised by the Ministry of National Education and the experience to carry out their functions, with specific dedication and availability for this purpose. To this end, marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments must ensure that the professional in charge is available to the organisation permanently and continuously, resides and operates in Colombia to meet the various requirements, and keeps their details updated through the means INVIMA provides for this purpose.

f.title: Document the functions and responsibilities of the PV programme lead
f.statement: The professional in charge of the pharmacovigilance programme must have duly documented functions and/or responsibilities to ensure the programme is carried out.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments
rows.quote: El profesional a cargo del programa de farmacovigilancia debe contar con funciones y/o responsabilidades debidamente documentadas para asegurar la ejecución del mismo.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The professional in charge of the pharmacovigilance programme must have duly documented functions and/or responsibilities to ensure its execution.

f.title: Register with the National Pharmacovigilance Network
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments must register with the National Pharmacovigilance Network through the mechanisms INVIMA establishes, taking into account INVIMA's updates.
f.clause: Artículo 5o. Inscripción a la Red Nacional de Farmacovigilancia

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments
rows.quote: Los titulares de registros sanitarios, laboratorios farmacéuticos, establecimientos fabricantes deben inscribirse a la Red Nacional de Farmacovigilancia, a través de los mecanismos que el Invima establezca para tal fin, sin desconocer las actualizaciones que el mismo Instituto realice al respecto.
rows.location: Artículo 5o. Inscripción a la Red Nacional de Farmacovigilancia
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments must register with the National Pharmacovigilance Network through the mechanisms that INVIMA establishes for this purpose, without disregarding the updates that the Institute makes in this regard.

f.title: Set up notification mechanisms for all adverse events and drug-related problems
f.statement: Holders, laboratories and manufacturers must establish within their pharmacovigilance programme mechanisms for notifying any adverse event, including adverse drug reactions, therapeutic failures, events supposedly attributable to vaccination or immunisation (ESAVI) and any other problem related to the use or consumption of their products, so that it is reported to INVIMA under this resolution.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments
rows.quote: Los titulares de registros sanitarios, laboratorios farmacéuticos, establecimientos fabricantes deben establecer, dentro de su programa de farmacovigilancia, los mecanismos de notificación de cualquier evento adverso, incluyendo reacciones adversas a medicamentos, fallos terapéuticos, eventos supuestamente atribuidos a la vacunación e inmunización (ESAVI) y/o cualquier otro problema relacionado con el uso o consumo de sus productos, con el fin de que éste sea reportado al Invima en los términos y condiciones establecidos en la presente resolución.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments must establish, within their pharmacovigilance programme, mechanisms for the notification of any adverse event, including adverse drug reactions, therapeutic failures, events supposedly attributable to vaccination and immunisation (ESAVI) and/or any other problem related to the use or consumption of their products, so that it is reported to INVIMA under the terms and conditions established in this resolution.

f.title: Capture safety information from all listed PV sources
f.statement: Information on risks and adverse events may come from: spontaneous reporting programmes; patient support programme records and any other systematic source of safety information; data on manufacture, storage, sale, distribution, dispensing, prescription and use, including utilisation studies; results of pre-authorisation and post-marketing studies or meta-analyses; scientific publications; information from other reference health authorities and international bodies; and any other source providing data on risks, including misuse, abuse, medication errors or occupational exposure relevant to benefit-risk.
f.clause: Artículo 6o, Parágrafo 1o. Fuentes de información en farmacovigilancia
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments
rows.quote: La información sobre los riesgos y eventos adversos asociados a la utilización de los productos objeto de la presente resolución, puede proceder de las siguientes fuentes:
rows.location: Artículo 6o, Parágrafo 1o. Fuentes de información en farmacovigilancia
rows.review_note: Review: list of possible sources ("puede proceder"); recorded as Permitted; source list (a-g) summarised from the paragraph. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: descriptive provision, statement beyond the quoted lead-in, 80.
rows.quote_en: Information on the risks and adverse events associated with the use of the products covered by this resolution may come from the following sources:

f.title: Hold MedDRA and WHODrug access to report ICH-compliant cases via eReporting Industria
f.statement: To meet the legal duty to notify adverse events, holders, laboratories and manufacturers must have access to the MedDRA and WHODrug coding systems to report adverse events meeting the ICH international standard through eReporting Industria, following INVIMA's published operating guidelines.
f.systems: MedDRA; WHODrug; eReporting Industria; ICH E2B

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments
rows.quote: Para efectos del cumplimiento del deber legal de notificación de eventos adversos los titulares de registros sanitarios, laboratorios farmacéuticos, establecimientos fabricantes deberán contar con los accesos al sistema de codificación MedDRA y WHODrug para el reporte de eventos adversos que cumplan con el estándar internacional de ICH a través de eReporting Industria
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: For the purposes of complying with the legal duty to notify adverse events, marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments shall have access to the MedDRA and WHODrug coding systems for reporting adverse events that meet the ICH international standard through eReporting Industria

f.title: Establish procedures for detecting, evaluating and preventing adverse events
f.statement: As part of their programme, holders, laboratories and manufacturers must establish procedures and mechanisms for the detection, evaluation and prevention of adverse events or any other medicine-related problem.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments
rows.quote: Establecer los procedimientos y mecanismos para el desarrollo del programa de Farmacovigilancia en cuanto a la detección, evaluación y prevención de los eventos adversos o cualquier otro problema relacionado con medicamentos y productos objeto de la presente resolución
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Establish the procedures and mechanisms for developing the Pharmacovigilance programme with regard to the detection, evaluation and prevention of adverse events or any other problem related to medicines and products covered by this resolution

f.title: Review safety alerts and reports from regulators where products are marketed
f.statement: Holders, laboratories and manufacturers must establish procedures, mechanisms and periodicity for reviewing the health alerts and safety reports published by the regulatory agencies of the countries where their products are marketed, in Colombia and abroad.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments
rows.quote: Establecer los procedimientos, mecanismos y periodicidad para la revisión de las alertas sanitarias e informes de seguridad publicadas por las agencias regulatorias, en las cuales, se comercialicen sus productos, tanto en Colombia como en otros países.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Establish the procedures, mechanisms and periodicity for reviewing the health alerts and safety reports published by the regulatory agencies in which their products are marketed, both in Colombia and in other countries.

f.title: Design a methodology to consolidate AEs and generate statistics for signal detection
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders must design a methodology that consolidates reported adverse events and generates statistics for signal detection for chemical-synthesis and biological medicines, as applicable.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: Diseñar la metodología que consolide los eventos adversos reportados y la generación de estadísticas para la detección de señales en medicamentos de síntesis química y medicamentos biológicos según aplique.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Design the methodology that consolidates the adverse events reported and the generation of statistics for signal detection in chemical-synthesis medicines and biological medicines as applicable.

f.title: Evaluate benefit-risk continuously through scientific literature searches
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders must continuously evaluate, by searching the scientific literature, the benefit-risk balance of the products they have authorised in Colombia, consolidating all new information that may affect the overall benefit-risk assessment or require changes to the summary of product characteristics, the package leaflet or both.
f.processes: Benefit–risk review; Signal detection; Safety labeling

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: Realizar una evaluación continua, mediante búsqueda de literatura científica, de la relación beneficio-riesgo de los productos objeto de la presente resolución, que tenga autorizados en Colombia, consolidando toda aquella nueva información que pueda influir en la evaluación global de la relación beneficio-riesgo o que pueda requerir la modificación de la ficha técnica, prospecto o ambos.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Carry out a continuous evaluation, by searching the scientific literature, of the benefit-risk balance of the products covered by this resolution that it has authorised in Colombia, consolidating all new information that may influence the overall evaluation of the benefit-risk balance or that may require modification of the summary of product characteristics, the package leaflet or both.

f.title: Report serious AEs and serious therapeutic failures to INVIMA within 15 calendar days
f.statement: Serious adverse events, expected or unexpected, and therapeutic failures with a serious adverse event outcome must be reported to INVIMA through eReporting Industria within fifteen (15) calendar days from the day after the event became known.
f.clause: Artículo 8o. Periodicidad de los reportes, numeral 1

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.deadline: 15 calendar days from the day after awareness
rows.quote: Los eventos adversos serios esperados e inesperados y fallos terapéuticos con desenlace de evento adverso serio: Deben ser comunicados al Invima dentro de los quince (15) días calendario a partir del día siguiente al que se haya tenido conocimiento del evento.
rows.location: Artículo 8o. Periodicidad de los reportes, numeral 1
rows.review_note: Review: the resolution does not distinguish domestic and foreign cases; origin any. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: Deben = Mandatory.
rows.quote_en: Serious adverse events, expected and unexpected, and therapeutic failures with a serious adverse event outcome: Must be communicated to INVIMA within fifteen (15) calendar days from the day following that on which the event became known.

deadline_rule.clock_start: a partir del día siguiente al que se haya tenido conocimiento del evento
deadline_rule.applies_to: serious expected and unexpected AEs; therapeutic failures with serious outcome

f.title: Report follow-up information on serious cases within 15 calendar days
f.statement: Where additional information to the initial serious report becomes available, the follow-up must be reported to INVIMA within the following fifteen (15) calendar days from the date it became known, linked to the same case code.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.deadline: 15 calendar days from awareness of follow-up information
rows.quote: En el caso que se presente información adicional a la inicialmente reportada según el código asignado, el seguimiento deberá ser reportado al Invima durante los siguientes quince (15) días calendario a partir de la fecha de su conocimiento y enlazado a ese mismo código.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Where additional information to that initially reported under the assigned code arises, the follow-up shall be reported to INVIMA within the following fifteen (15) calendar days from the date it became known and linked to that same code.

deadline_rule.clock_start: a partir de la fecha de su conocimiento
deadline_rule.applies_to: follow-up information on serious AE / serious therapeutic failure reports

f.title: Report non-serious AEs and non-serious therapeutic failures within 90 calendar days
f.statement: Non-serious adverse events, expected or unexpected, and therapeutic failures without a serious adverse event outcome must be reported to INVIMA within ninety (90) calendar days from the day after they became known.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.deadline: 90 calendar days from the day after awareness
rows.quote: Los eventos adversos no serios esperados e inesperados y fallos terapéuticos sin desenlace de evento adverso serio: Deben ser comunicados al Invima dentro de los noventa (90) días calendario a partir del día siguiente al que se haya tenido conocimiento de este.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Non-serious adverse events, expected and unexpected, and therapeutic failures without a serious adverse event outcome: Must be communicated to INVIMA within ninety (90) calendar days from the day following that on which it became known.

deadline_rule.clock_start: a partir del día siguiente al que se haya tenido conocimiento de este
deadline_rule.applies_to: non-serious expected and unexpected AEs; therapeutic failures without serious outcome

f.title: Report follow-up information on non-serious cases within 30 calendar days
f.statement: Where additional information to the initial non-serious report becomes available, the follow-up must be reported to INVIMA within the following thirty (30) calendar days from the date it became known, linked to the same code.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.deadline: 30 calendar days from awareness of follow-up information
rows.quote: el seguimiento de este evento no serio deberá ser reportado al Invima durante los siguientes treinta (30) días calendario a partir de la fecha de su conocimiento y enlazado a ese mismo código.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: the follow-up of this non-serious event shall be reported to INVIMA within the following thirty (30) calendar days from the date it became known and linked to that same code.

deadline_rule.clock_start: a partir de la fecha de su conocimiento
deadline_rule.applies_to: follow-up information on non-serious AE reports

f.title: File a quarterly no-event report on the first business day of the next quarter
f.statement: If no adverse events are identified for all of the establishment's chemical-synthesis medicines, medicinal gases, biological medicines and phytotherapeutic products during a calendar quarter, a no-event report must be filed with INVIMA on the first business day of the following quarter.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.deadline: First business day of the following calendar quarter
rows.quote: En caso de que no se identifiquen Eventos Adversos, para el total de los medicamentos de síntesis química, gases medicinales, medicamentos biológicos, productos fitoterapéuticos, del establecimiento farmacéutico durante cada trimestre del calendario anual, deberá informar como reporte sin evento al INVIMA el primer día hábil del siguiente trimestre.
rows.review_note: Review: recurring quarterly date, no deadline_rule. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: deberá = Mandatory.
rows.quote_en: Where no Adverse Events are identified for all the chemical-synthesis medicines, medicinal gases, biological medicines and phytotherapeutic products of the pharmaceutical establishment during each quarter of the calendar year, it shall inform INVIMA by a no-event report on the first business day of the following quarter.

f.title: Use literature-identified AEs only in PSURs, not as individual reports
f.statement: Adverse events identified through review of the scientific literature are used only to build and contribute safety information to the periodic safety update reports (PSURs).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: aquellos eventos adversos identificados a través de la revisión de literatura científica solamente serán utilizados para construir y aportar la información de seguridad de los Informes periódicos de seguridad PSUR.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: those adverse events identified through review of the scientific literature shall only be used to build and contribute the safety information of the periodic safety reports (PSUR).

f.title: Report product health alerts in Colombia or abroad within 5 business days
f.statement: Health alerts concerning the products, in Colombia and in other countries, must be reported to INVIMA within five (5) business days of publication of the alert, by the means INVIMA establishes.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.deadline: 5 business days from publication of the alert
rows.quote: Las alertas sanitarias de las cuales hayan sido objeto los productos objeto de la presente resolución en Colombia y en otros países, deben ser reportadas al Invima en un plazo no mayor a los cinco (5) días hábiles a partir de la publicación de la respectiva alerta.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Health alerts to which the products covered by this resolution have been subject in Colombia and in other countries must be reported to INVIMA within a period of no more than five (5) business days from the publication of the respective alert.

deadline_rule.clock_start: a partir de la publicación de la respectiva alerta
deadline_rule.applies_to: health alerts on the products in Colombia and abroad

f.title: Submit a preventive/corrective work plan for health alerts within 45 calendar days
f.statement: Where a health alert concerns a product, the marketing authorisation holder must prepare a work plan with the preventive and/or corrective actions to be taken and submit it to INVIMA within forty-five (45) calendar days from the day the alert was published.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.deadline: 45 calendar days from publication of the alert
rows.quote: En el caso que se presenten alertas sanitarias, con algún producto objeto de la presente resolución, los titulares de registros sanitarios deben generar un plan de trabajo con las acciones preventivas y/o correctivas a realizar, el cual debe ser presentado ante el Invima en un tiempo no mayor a cuarenta y cinco (45) días calendario a partir del día de la publicación de la respectiva alerta.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Where health alerts arise concerning any product covered by this resolution, marketing authorisation holders must generate a work plan with the preventive and/or corrective actions to be carried out, which must be submitted to INVIMA within no more than forty-five (45) calendar days from the day of publication of the respective alert.

deadline_rule.clock_start: a partir del día de la publicación de la respectiva alerta
deadline_rule.applies_to: work plan for health alerts on the products

f.title: Make the MAH responsible for reporting; manufacturers inform the MAH immediately
f.statement: Responsibility for reporting and its content lies with the marketing authorisation holder. Where the adverse event becomes known to the manufacturing establishment or the pharmaceutical laboratory contracted for manufacture, it must inform the marketing authorisation holder immediately so that it is reported to INVIMA under this resolution.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder; contract manufacturer or pharmaceutical laboratory
rows.quote: La responsabilidad del reporte y su contenido descrito anteriormente será del Titular del Registro de Sanitario. En el caso de que el evento adverso sea conocido por el establecimiento fabricante o el laboratorio farmacéutico contratado para la fabricación, este lo debe informar al titular del registro sanitario inmediatamente, con el fin de que se reporte al INVIMA en los términos y condiciones establecidos por la presente resolución.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Responsibility for the report and its content described above shall lie with the Marketing Authorisation Holder. Where the adverse event becomes known to the manufacturing establishment or the pharmaceutical laboratory contracted for manufacture, it must inform the marketing authorisation holder immediately, so that it is reported to INVIMA under the terms and conditions established by this resolution.

f.title: Submit AE reports in Spanish coded with MedDRA and WHODrug
f.statement: Adverse event reports must be submitted in Spanish and coded with MedDRA and WHODrug, following the mechanisms INVIMA establishes.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: Los reportes de eventos adversos asociados a los productos objeto de la presente resolución, se deben presentar en idioma español y con la codificación MedDRA y WHODrug cumpliendo los mecanismos que el Invima establezca para tal fin.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Reports of adverse events associated with the products covered by this resolution must be submitted in the Spanish language and with MedDRA and WHODrug coding, complying with the mechanisms that INVIMA establishes for this purpose.

f.title: Report fatal cases only with a possible association and minimum data
f.statement: Adverse events or other drug-related problems with a fatal outcome are reportable only where there is a possible association between an adverse reaction and the fatal outcome, and must include at least the medicine, date of administration, the adverse reaction, date of onset of the reaction and the case narrative.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: Los eventos adversos o cualquier otro problema relacionado con medicamentos con desenlace fatal solamente serán motivo de reporte, cuando exista la posible asociación entre una reacción adversa y el desenlace fatal, como mínimo con la información del medicamento, fecha de administración, la reacción adversa, fecha de ocurrencia de la reacción adversa y el caso narrativo.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Adverse events or any other medicine-related problem with a fatal outcome shall only be reportable where there is a possible association between an adverse reaction and the fatal outcome, at a minimum with information on the medicine, date of administration, the adverse reaction, date of occurrence of the adverse reaction and the case narrative.

f.title: Maintain PSUR-PBRERs in line with INVIMA guidelines
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders must have Periodic Safety Update Reports (PSUR-PBRER), complying with the guidelines and requirements INVIMA sets for their benefit-risk analysis.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: Los titulares de registro sanitario deben contar con Informes Periódicos de Seguridad (PSUR – PBRER), dando cumplimiento a los lineamientos y requerimientos establecidos por el Invima para el análisis beneficio-riesgo de estos
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Marketing authorisation holders must have Periodic Safety Reports (PSUR-PBRER), complying with the guidelines and requirements established by INVIMA for their benefit-risk analysis

f.title: Align PSUR frequency and data lock points with the EU EURD list
f.statement: Periodic safety reports must follow the preparation frequency and data lock point set in the European Union reference dates (EURD) list for each active substance.
f.clause: Artículo 10. Periodicidad de los informes de seguridad

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: Los informes periódicos de seguridad deben coincidir con la frecuencia de elaboración y fecha de cierre de datos establecida por las listas de FECHAS DE REFERENCIA DE LA UNIÓN EUROPEA (EURD) para cada principio activo
rows.location: Artículo 10. Periodicidad de los informes de seguridad
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Periodic safety reports must coincide with the preparation frequency and data lock point established by the EUROPEAN UNION REFERENCE DATES (EURD) lists for each active substance

f.title: Submit a PSUR within 5 business days of an INVIMA request
f.statement: INVIMA may request periodic safety reports; the holder then has five (5) business days from notification of the request to submit them.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.deadline: 5 business days from communication of INVIMA's request
rows.quote: El Invima se reserva el derecho de solicitar los informes periódicos de seguridad, tras lo cual se tendrá un plazo de cinco (5) días hábiles para su presentación a partir de la comunicación del requerimiento surtido por la entidad.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: INVIMA reserves the right to request the periodic safety reports, after which there shall be a period of five (5) business days for their submission from the communication of the request made by the entity.

deadline_rule.clock_start: a partir de la comunicación del requerimiento surtido por la entidad

f.title: Keep PSURs permanently available instead of submitting them routinely
f.statement: PSUR-PBRERs are not to be sent to INVIMA but must be permanently available to it in case INVIMA requires them during inspection, surveillance and control activities.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: Los Informes Periódicos de Seguridad (PSUR – PBRER) no deben ser enviados al Invima, pero deben estar a disposición permanente del instituto, en caso de que el Invima así lo requiera durante las actividades de inspección, vigilancia y control.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Periodic Safety Reports (PSUR-PBRER) must not be sent to INVIMA, but must be permanently available to the institute, should INVIMA so require during inspection, surveillance and control activities.

f.title: Provide the PSUR executive summary in Spanish when requested
f.statement: When INVIMA requests a PSUR-PBRER, its executive summary must be submitted in Spanish.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: El resumen ejecutivo del PSUR-PBRER debe ser presentado en idioma español, cuando el PSUR-PBRER sea solicitado por Invima.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The executive summary of the PSUR-PBRER must be submitted in the Spanish language when the PSUR-PBRER is requested by INVIMA.

f.title: Maintain risk management plans under Resolution 213 of 2022
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders must have Risk Management Plans (PGR) as established in Resolution No. 213 of 2022 (or its replacement), complying with the guidelines and requirements of the Ministry of Health and Social Protection and INVIMA.
f.clause: Artículo 11. Planes de gestión de riesgo

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: Los Titulares de Registro Sanitario deben contar con Planes de Gestión de Riesgo (PGR) según lo establecido en la Resolución número 213 de 2022, o la que la modifique o sustituya dando cumplimiento a los lineamientos y requerimientos establecidos por el Ministerio de Salud y Protección Social y el Invima.
rows.location: Artículo 11. Planes de gestión de riesgo
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Marketing Authorisation Holders must have Risk Management Plans (PGR) as established in Resolution No. 213 of 2022, or the one that amends or replaces it, complying with the guidelines and requirements established by the Ministry of Health and Social Protection and INVIMA.

f.title: Submit post-marketing safety study results at completion or earlier if B/R worsens
f.statement: INVIMA may request post-marketing studies within an active pharmacovigilance programme from those responsible for biological medicines, as a condition of the registration or where doubts about safety arise after approval. The results of post-marketing safety studies required by INVIMA, or that the holder decides to carry out, must be submitted to INVIMA in a report at the end of the study, or earlier when safety conditions arise that adversely affect the benefit-risk profile.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: Los resultados de los estudios pos-comercialización de seguridad requeridos por el Invima o que el Titular de Registro Sanitario considere pertinentes realizar, deben ser presentados al Instituto en un informe al finalizar el mismo, o antes, cuando se presenten condiciones de seguridad que afecten negativamente el perfil beneficio-riesgo del producto farmacéutico objeto de la presente resolución, a través del medio que el Instituto establezca para el efecto.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The results of post-marketing safety studies required by INVIMA or that the Marketing Authorisation Holder considers appropriate to carry out must be submitted to the Institute in a report at its completion, or earlier, when safety conditions arise that negatively affect the benefit-risk profile of the pharmaceutical product covered by this resolution, through the means the Institute establishes for this purpose.

f.title: Keep responsibility when outsourcing reporting and file the agreement within 5 business days
f.statement: The holder or manufacturer may, under its sole responsibility, report through a third party without transferring the obligation. It must send INVIMA the document setting out the responsibilities and conditions of the reporting within 5 business days of signing it. Outsourcing does not exempt the holder or manufacturer from responsibility; the agent always acts in its name and at its risk and is subject to inspection, surveillance and control.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder or manufacturer
rows.deadline: 5 business days from signature of the outsourcing document
rows.quote: El titular de registro sanitario o fabricante bajo su exclusiva responsabilidad podrá reportar la información de la que habla esta norma a través de un tercero sin que con ello pueda entenderse que transfiere esta obligación. El titular o fabricante allegará al Invima el documento que soporte las responsabilidades y condiciones del reporte a efectos del respectivo seguimiento desde el programa de farmacovigilancia dentro de los 5 días hábiles siguientes a partir de la firma del documento.
rows.review_note: Review: combines the permission (podrá) and the 5-day filing duty; level follows the filing duty (allegará = Mandatory). Re-translation agrees. Double-check: headline duty Mandatory.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder or manufacturer, under its sole responsibility, may report the information referred to in this standard through a third party without this being understood as transferring this obligation. The holder or manufacturer shall provide INVIMA with the document supporting the responsibilities and conditions of the reporting, for follow-up by the pharmacovigilance programme, within the 5 business days following the signature of the document.

deadline_rule.clock_start: a partir de la firma del documento

f.title: Apply Arts 3-8 to medicinal gases and phytotherapeutics; no PSUR, RMP or PASS
f.statement: Holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturers of medicinal gases and phytotherapeutic products, including medicinal cannabis derivatives, must comply with Articles 3 to 8 (programme, responsible person, registration, notification mechanisms, activities and reporting periodicity); they are not subject to periodic safety reports, risk management plans or post-marketing studies.
f.clause: Artículo 14. Gases medicinales y productos fitoterapéuticos
f.applicability: Medicinal gases; phytotherapeutic products incl. medicinal cannabis derivatives
f.exceptions: Not subject to PSUR, RMP or post-marketing studies

rows.actor: Holders and manufacturers of medicinal gases and phytotherapeutic products (including medicinal cannabis derivatives)
rows.quote: Los Titulares de Registro Sanitario, los laboratorios farmacéuticos y establecimientos fabricantes de gases medicinales, productos fitoterapéuticos incluidos aquellos productos derivados de cannabis medicinal cumplirán con lo establecido en los artículos 3o , 4o , 5o , 6o , 7o y 8o de la presente resolución. Por lo anterior, no estarán sujetos a la elaboración de informes periódicos de seguridad, planes de gestión de riesgos y estudios pos-comercialización.
rows.location: Artículo 14. Gases medicinales y productos fitoterapéuticos
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Marketing Authorisation Holders, pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturing establishments of medicinal gases and phytotherapeutic products, including products derived from medicinal cannabis, shall comply with Articles 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8 of this resolution. Consequently, they shall not be subject to the preparation of periodic safety reports, risk management plans and post-marketing studies.

f.title: Apply Arts 3-6 to manufacturers that are not marketing authorisation holders
f.statement: Manufacturing establishments (laboratory or contract manufacturer) that are not marketing authorisation holders must comply with Articles 3 to 6 as responsible for the safety of the products they manufacture; they are not subject to reporting periodicity, periodic safety reports, risk management plans or post-marketing studies.
f.exceptions: Not subject to reporting periodicity, PSUR, RMP or post-marketing studies

rows.actor: Manufacturing establishments (laboratory or contract manufacturer) that are not marketing authorisation holders
rows.quote: Los establecimientos fabricantes (laboratorio o maquila) que no sean titulares de registro sanitario deberán cumplir con los artículos 3o , 4o , 5o y 6o de la presente resolución, como responsables de la seguridad de los productos que fabrica, en el ámbito de la Farmacovigilancia.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Manufacturing establishments (laboratory or contract manufacturer) that are not marketing authorisation holders shall comply with Articles 3, 4, 5 and 6 of this resolution, as responsible for the safety of the products they manufacture, within the scope of Pharmacovigilance.

f.title: Apply serious, non-serious and no-event reporting rules to certified compounding establishments
f.statement: Manufacturing establishments independent of a health-care provider that prepare magistral preparations, parenteral nutrition, oncology mixtures and concentration adjustments, repackaging of non-sterile oral solids and/or extemporaneous preparations, certified in Good Compounding Practices, must comply with Article 8 numerals 1, 2 and 3 (serious, non-serious and no-event reporting); their pharmacovigilance programme follows the technical annex of Resolution 0444 of 2008.
f.clause: Artículo 16. Establecimientos certificados en Buenas Prácticas de Elaboración
f.applicability: Certified compounding establishments independent of health-care providers

rows.actor: Establishments certified in Good Compounding Practices independent of a health-care provider
rows.quote: debidamente certificados en Buenas Prácticas de Elaboración, cumplirán con lo establecido en el artículo 8o de la presente resolución en sus numerales 1, 2 y 3. Para el programa de Farmacovigilancia cumplirán con lo establecido en el anexo técnico de la Resolución número 0444 de 2008 o la norma que la modifique o sustituya.
rows.location: Artículo 16. Establecimientos certificados en Buenas Prácticas de Elaboración
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: duly certified in Good Compounding Practices, shall comply with the provisions of Article 8 of this resolution in its numerals 1, 2 and 3. For the Pharmacovigilance programme they shall comply with the provisions of the technical annex of Resolution No. 0444 of 2008 or the standard that amends or replaces it.

f.title: Apply serious and non-serious reporting rules to radiopharmaceutical establishments
f.statement: Manufacturing establishments independent of a health-care provider that prepare, adjust, refill and/or repackage radiopharmaceutical doses, certified in Good Radiopharmaceutical Preparation Practices, must comply with Article 8 numerals 1 and 2; their pharmacovigilance programme follows the technical annex of Resolution 4245 of 2015, and INVIMA will set the eReporting Industria mechanisms for radiopharmaceuticals.

rows.actor: Radiopharmaceutical establishments certified in Good Radiopharmaceutical Preparation Practices
rows.quote: debidamente certificados en Buenas Prácticas de Elaboración de Radiofármacos, cumplirán con lo establecido en el artículo 8o de la presente resolución en sus numerales 1 y 2. Para el programa de Farmacovigilancia cumplirán con lo establecido en el anexo técnico de la Resolución número 4245 de 2015 o la que la modifique o sustituya.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: duly certified in Good Radiopharmaceutical Preparation Practices, shall comply with the provisions of Article 8 of this resolution in its numerals 1 and 2. For the Pharmacovigilance programme they shall comply with the provisions of the technical annex of Resolution No. 4245 of 2015 or the one that amends or replaces it.

f.title: Report serious and non-serious AEs with vital unavailable medicines within 15 calendar days
f.statement: Public or private entities authorised by INVIMA to import vital medicines not available must report serious and non-serious adverse events to INVIMA, directly or through an authorised third party, within fifteen (15) calendar days from the day after the event became known, through the eReporting Industria interfaces INVIMA establishes.

rows.actor: Public or private entities authorised by INVIMA to import vital medicines not available (MVND)
rows.deadline: 15 calendar days from the day after awareness
rows.quote: Las entidades públicas o privadas legalmente constituidas, autorizadas por el Invima para la importación de medicamentos vitales no disponibles comunicarán al Invima, directamente o a través de un tercero autorizado, los eventos adversos serios y no serios dentro de los quince (15) días calendario a partir del día siguiente al que se haya tenido conocimiento del evento adverso.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Legally constituted public or private entities authorised by INVIMA to import vital medicines not available shall communicate to INVIMA, directly or through an authorised third party, serious and non-serious adverse events within fifteen (15) calendar days from the day following that on which the adverse event became known.

deadline_rule.clock_start: a partir del día siguiente al que se haya tenido conocimiento del evento adverso
deadline_rule.applies_to: serious and non-serious AEs with vital medicines not available

f.title: Report vital-unavailable-medicine AEs in VigiFlow when eReporting Industria does not apply
f.statement: If eReporting Industria access does not apply to the importing entity, the health-care provider is responsible for notifying in VigiFlow any adverse event associated with a vital medicine not available; independent patients or health professionals report directly on the patient and health-professional eReporting platform.

rows.actor: Health-care provider (where the importing entity has no eReporting Industria access)
rows.quote: Si una entidad pública o privada legalmente constituida no le aplica el acceso a eReporting Industria, será el prestador de servicios de salud el responsable de notificar en el Sistema VigiFlow cualquier evento adverso asociado a un medicamento vital no disponible.
rows.review_note: Review: actor is the health-care provider, not a company. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: non-company actor, 86.
rows.quote_en: If access to eReporting Industria does not apply to a legally constituted public or private entity, the health-care service provider shall be responsible for notifying in the VigiFlow System any adverse event associated with a vital medicine not available.

f.title: Report import and distribution data for multi-patient vital medicines every 3 months
f.statement: Entities granted authorisation to import or manufacture vital medicines not available for more than one patient must report to INVIMA within three (3) months of the import authorisation date and every three (3) months thereafter, until the product is used up or expires: nationalisation or manufacture date (or reasons if not done), quantity, expiry date, batch and manufacturer, name and address of the storage establishment, and the entities supplied with the quantities distributed.
f.clause: Artículo 19. Reporte de información de medicamentos vitales no disponibles para más de un paciente

rows.actor: Entities authorised to import or manufacture vital medicines not available for more than one patient
rows.deadline: Within 3 months of import authorisation, then every 3 months
rows.quote: deberán reportar al Invima, a través del mecanismo que el instituto establezca para el efecto, dentro de los tres (3) meses siguientes a la fecha de autorización de importación y posteriormente cada tres (3) meses, hasta el agotamiento o vencimiento del producto, la siguiente información:
rows.location: Artículo 19. Reporte de información de medicamentos vitales no disponibles para más de un paciente
rows.review_note: Review: supply-traceability report rather than safety data, kept as it sits in the PV resolution for IVC purposes; data items summarised from numerals 1-5. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 86.
rows.quote_en: shall report to INVIMA, through the mechanism the institute establishes for this purpose, within the three (3) months following the date of import authorisation and thereafter every three (3) months, until the product is exhausted or expires, the following information:

deadline_rule.applies_to: first supply/distribution report for multi-patient vital medicines not available

f.title: Be ready for INVIMA pharmacovigilance inspections
f.statement: INVIMA verifies compliance with this resolution through inspection, surveillance and control visits to marketing authorisation holders, manufacturing establishments and/or pharmaceutical laboratories and importers where applicable.
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders, manufacturing establishments, pharmaceutical laboratories and importers where applicable
rows.quote: El Invima en el ámbito de sus competencias verificará el cumplimiento de lo dispuesto en la presente resolución, mediante visitas de inspección, vigilancia y control a los titulares de registro sanitario, establecimientos fabricantes y/o laboratorios farmacéuticos y a los importadores cuando corresponda.
rows.review_note: Review: authority power; company consequence is inspection readiness. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 86.
rows.quote_en: INVIMA, within the scope of its competences, shall verify compliance with the provisions of this resolution through inspection, surveillance and control visits to marketing authorisation holders, manufacturing establishments and/or pharmaceutical laboratories and to importers where applicable.

f.title: Report safety information mandatorily, on time and with quality; non-compliance is sanctioned
f.statement: Holders, laboratories, manufacturers and importers are responsible for mandatory, timely and continuous reporting of truthful, quality information for public-health surveillance, within the terms of responsibility, seriousness classification, periodicity, destination and clarity. Failure to comply with the content, periodicity and procedures of the reports and pharmacovigilance programmes or any obligation of this resolution may lead INVIMA to start sanction proceedings and apply measures, including Article 51 of Law 1437 of 2011.
f.clause: Artículo 21. Responsabilidades frente a la obligatoriedad de la información

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories, manufacturing establishments and importers where applicable
rows.quote: Los titulares de registros sanitarios, los laboratorios farmacéuticos, establecimientos fabricantes e importadores cuando corresponda son responsables del reporte obligatorio, oportuno y continuo, de información veraz y de calidad requerida para la vigilancia en salud pública, dentro de los términos de responsabilidad, clasificación de seriedad, periodicidad, destino y claridad.
rows.location: Artículo 21. Responsabilidades frente a la obligatoriedad de la información
rows.review_note: Review: sanction sentence summarised from the rest of Art. 21. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 88.
rows.quote_en: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories, manufacturing establishments and importers where applicable are responsible for the mandatory, timely and continuous reporting of truthful and quality information required for public health surveillance, within the terms of responsibility, seriousness classification, periodicity, destination and clarity.

dates.title: INVIMA Resolution 2024015321 (PV reporting and programmes): enters into force
dates.scope: Marketing authorisation holders, pharmaceutical laboratories, manufacturing establishments and importers of chemical-synthesis medicines, medicinal gases, biologicals and phytotherapeutics; also radiopharmaceutical, compounding and vital-unavailable-medicine reporters. Repeals Resolution 2004009455 from that date.
dates.quote: La presente resolución rige a partir del 1 de marzo de 2025 y deroga la Resolución número 200400 9455 del 28 de mayo de 2004 una vez entre en vigencia.
dates.quote_en: This resolution applies from 1 March 2025 and repeals Resolution No. 2004009455 of 28 May 2004 once it enters into force.
dates.timing_note: Issued 8 April 2024, published in Diario Oficial No. 52.731 of 18 April 2024; applies from 1 March 2025.
